item.name: Barcode Generator (Code 128, EAN-13) SVG
item.description:
Generate scannable Code 128 and EAN-13 barcodes as crisp SVG, with automatic check digit, custom height and bar width.

Docs: https://developers.tidydata.workers.dev/barcode-generator/

item.name: Business Days Calculator (holidays aware)
item.description:
Count working days between two dates and add/subtract business days, skipping weekends and the public holidays of 100+ countries and regions. Custom weekend days.

Docs: https://developers.tidydata.workers.dev/business-days-calculator/

response.name: Example
response.body:
{
  "start": "2026-12-01",
  "end": "2026-12-31",
  "calendarDays": 31,
  "businessDays": 21,
  "weekendDays": 8,
  "holidaysOnWeekdays": [
    "2026-12-08",
    "2026-12-25"
  ],
  "country": "ES",
  "note": "Both start and end dates included."
}

item.name: Color Converter, Palettes & Contrast Checker
item.description:
Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, get complementary, analogous, triadic palettes, shades and tints, the best text color and WCAG contrast ratio.

item.name: Company Logo API
item.description:
Get any company's logo and icon from its domain: best square icon at your size, full logo, brand color and site name, or the image itself. Initials fallback. Replacement for the retired Clearbit Logo API.

Docs: https://developers.tidydata.workers.dev/company-logo/

Detect 130+ technologies a website uses: CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow), frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue), analytics and pixels, chat, CDN and hosting. Great for lead generation and competitor research.

Docs: https://developers.tidydata.workers.dev/website-technology-lookup/

item.name: XML, YAML & JSON Converter
item.description:
Convert XML to JSON (attributes kept with @), JSON to XML, YAML to JSON and JSON to YAML. POST the document, get the converted result.

Docs: https://developers.tidydata.workers.dev/xml-yaml-json-converter/

item.name: Zodiac Sign API - Western and Chinese Astrology
item.description:
Exact zodiac sign from a birth date, time and time zone (computed from the Sun's real position, so cusp birthdays are right) plus the Chinese zodiac from the real lunisolar calendar: animal, element, yin/yang and the year's start and end dates.

Docs: https://developers.tidydata.workers.dev/zodiac-sign/
